item.title: Show HN: Hibi – a calendar app to remember your days
item.summary: Hey HN! Most calendar apps are good at showing what you have planned. They are not very good at capturing what the day was actually like. So I built Hibi, a customizable digital planner and calendar for iPhone and iPad. Every day has its own paper-like page. You can change the paper, draw on it, add text, stickers, and Washi tape, while keeping the events and reminders already on your device. I wanted something practical enough to use as my everyday calendar, but personal enough to capture more than appointments. A place to make each day feel like mine and remember it when I look back. Hibi is free to try on the App Store. I built it as a solo indie project and would love to hear what you think. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762520622 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49311185 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
